messages:
sofie: Heads up — packaging finished the sealed bundle for private-installer v1.9.2. Need transport ETA and KMS handoff before we hit deploybot. Checksums attached below.

raj: ETA from carrier? who is escort on this one?

marco: Carrier ETA to our staging relay is 2025-11-06 01:30 UTC. We need ~30m for unpack + verify + cosign. Requesting deploy window 02:00-02:30 UTC.

ella: Can we parallelize unpack + digest verify to squeeze the window? Might shave ~10m, but only if cosign keys are ready.

sofie: Prefer to keep 30m buffer. If any signature/check fails we should abort and roll back. Proposed rollback: re-pin manifest to v1.9.1 and abort transport.

deploy-bot: [SCHEDULE] private-installer-v1.9.2 scheduled for 2025-11-06T02:00:00Z. Canary: staging (2 nodes). Window: 30m. Timeout: 00:30:00. React with :eyes: to acknowledge.

raj: OK I'm on call for the window. Quick checklist: cosign sigs present, sha256 checksums match, shrinkwrap manifest updated, KMS key version 3.1 available, and escort has ferry key rotation token.

marco: Cosign signatures are produced and attached to the bundle. Manifest v1.9.2 baked. Ferry key rotation is pending until KMS confirms availability (waiting on ops-escort).

ella: Release notes stub for marketing: 'Private installer v1.9.2: packaging fixes and signing improvements.' Will expand after final verification.

sofie: Rollback criteria spelled out: checksum mismatch OR cosign verify failure OR signer key version mismatch -> immediate hold. Operators should run `/deploy cancel private-installer-v1.9.2` and we re-pin manifest to v1.9.1, then notify carrier. Raj will confirm backstop actions.

raj: Acknowledged. I'll add a deploybot abort shortcut and contact carrier ops. I'll post final GO here 15m before the window.

deploy-bot: [ACTION] Canary verification passed on staging (2/2). Proceeding to transport handoff in 10m. Artifact digest: `sha256:abc123def4567890efgh...` Cosign: `cosign.sig:MEUCIQ...`

ella: :thumbsup:

sofie: Thanks all. Attaching the shrinkwrap checklist and cosign output for the record:

```
COSIGN: cosign.sig
SHA256: abc123def4567890efghijklmnopqrstuvwx
SHRINKWRAP: manifest-v1.9.2-sha256: zx9a7b6c5d4e3f2g1
KMS: key-version: 3.1
ESCORT: ferry-token-id: ferry-4571
```

raj: I'll be in the channel during the whole window. If we need to abort, I'll run the cancel and call out the rollback pins.

sofie: Great. Please tag me @sofie when you hit cancel. Otherwise we proceed.

marco: Noted. Will stage the offload and keep logs open.

deploy-bot: [FINAL] Transport handoff complete. Deploy window closed. No rollback triggered. Logs archived at: https://infra.redwood/logs/transport/1758004321

ella: Nice work, team. Will draft full release notes tomorrow and paste here.
